subject: Proposed staggered demo windows to accommodate APAC Golden Week & EU/US DST
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Kenji Suzuki <ksuzuki@kairotech.jp>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + 60m demo — availability next week?

Hi Kenji —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We’d love to do a 60‑minute product demo tailored to your ML platform team (focus: inference integration, cost controls, and private deploy options). To make this low friction across your regional stakeholders, I wanted to propose a few windows that cover US / EU / APAC overlap.

Proposed demo windows (pick one):
- Option A (US‑friendly): 08:00–09:00 PT / 16:00–17:00 GMT / 00:00–01:00 JST (next day)
- Option B (EU‑friendly): 11:00–12:00 PT / 19:00–20:00 GMT / 03:00–04:00 JST (next day)
- Option C (staggered): Split into two 30m blocks — 09:00–09:30 PT / 17:00–17:30 GMT (block 1) and 23:00–23:30 PT / 07:00–07:30 GMT (block 2) — lets you include APAC asynchronously.

A couple quick notes:
- We know Golden Week in Japan is coming up the week after next; if Kenji’s team has limited coverage we can either (a) switch to the staggered option so APAC gets a recorded + live Q&A slot, or (b) bump the live review until the week after.
- There’s a US DST change on Nov 1st which can shift local times — I’ll avoid scheduling exactly on that night.

I attached a short demo agenda and a calendar options file. If none of the slots work, tell me the best local times for your teams and we’ll rework.

Thanks —
Sergio
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
+1 415‑555‑0123

Attachments: demo-agenda.pdf (pdf)
From: Kenji Suzuki <ksuzuki@kairotech.jp>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:14:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Intro + 60m demo — availability next week?

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the options. Apologies — Golden Week here starts earlier than usual for several teams due to internal maintenance: many folks will be OOO from Nov 1 through Nov 5 and I’ll only have skeleton coverage.

Option A and B both push the live session into very late local hours for our ML infra engineers. The staggered two‑block approach looks promising since it means APAC can watch a recording and join a shorter Q&A during normal hours. Two small asks:
- If we go staggered, can you ensure the recording + Q&A start before our Nov 1st holiday window?
- Also — we have a couple of EU partners in different DST offsets; are the times specified in GMT/UTC? With the EU DST change last week some of our team is still adjusting calendars.

Kenji
Head of Platform Engineering, KairoTech
ksuzuki@kairotech.jp
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Kenji Suzuki <ksuzuki@kairotech.jp>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + 60m demo — availability next week?

Kenji — thanks for the context. Good questions — times above are listed in PT / GMT / JST respectively; we’ll make the calendar invites in UTC to avoid DST confusion.

Proposal to address both constraints:
1) Record a 30m walkthrough (technical + example integration) and make it available by Oct 31.
2) Host two live Q&A blocks on Oct 31 (EU/Americas friendly) and Nov 2 (APAC friendly) — both 30m.

Proposed schedule (UTC):
- Recording posted: 2026‑10‑31T15:00:00Z (to give your team time before Golden Week)
- Live Q&A 1 (Amer/EMEA): 2026‑10‑31T17:00:00Z — 30m
- Live Q&A 2 (APAC): 2026‑11‑02T02:00:00Z — 30m (we can confirm if this is acceptable)

If that works I’ll send two distinct calendar invites and a short agenda. I’ll also include an explicit timezone conversion table so EU folks aren’t bitten by the DST change last weekend.

Laura / Karthik — any red flags from your side for the split schedule?

Thanks —
Sergio
From: María López <maria.lopez@zencart.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Kenji Suzuki <ksuzuki@kairotech.jp>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Intro + 60m demo — availability next week?

Hi Sergio / Kenji —

I’m joining on behalf of Zencart (we’re a potential integration partner). Two notes from our side:
- Nov 2nd at 02:00Z is extremely early for our Tokyo/Seoul contributors; we’d prefer the APAC Q&A be scheduled between 23:00–01:00Z so folks can still join before midnight local.
- We also have a bank holiday in some EU offices on Nov 2nd that will reduce coverage. If possible, could you make the APAC Q&A 2026‑11‑02T00:00:00Z (30m) instead of 02:00Z? That still leaves the Americas/EU slot on Oct 31st unaffected.

If you can shift the APAC Q&A earlier by two hours, we’ll confirm attendance from our side.

Best,
María
Solutions Lead, Zencart

Sergio — I’ll finish the invites and send them from the Redwood calendar. Please confirm and I’ll CC the invites to the lists provided.
